correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the shortest-path interval operator exactly: cross-part pairs are adjacent and add nothing, while same-part pairs add every vertex outside that part. The bundled verifier independently reconstructs graph distances and iterates the literal interval closure for every subset of every complete-multipartite profile through order nine, matching all formulas. The finite check supports but does not replace the infinite proof.
